mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS (ORDER_NO, USER_ID, TOTAL_PRICE, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_STATUS) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, SYSDATE, #{status})
INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM (ORDER_NO, REG_ID, ORDER_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_TOTAL) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{regId}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{itemTotal})

INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAY_NO, IMP_UID, PAY_METHOD, PAY_AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, REQUEST_AT, PAID_AT, FAIL_REASON, ORDER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAY_NO.NEXTVAL, #{impUid}, #{payMethod}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{failReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT WHERE IMP_UID = #{value}

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, p.pay_no AS payNo, p.pay_status AS payStatus, p.pay_amount AS payAmount FROM orders o JOIN payment p ON p.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET pay_status = 'CANCELED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND pay_status = 'PAID'
UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'CANCELED' WHERE order_no = #{value} AND order_status IN ('PAID','CONFIRMED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund ( refund_no, pay_no, refund_amount, refund_status, refund_date, reason ) VALUES ( seq_refund_no.nextval, #{payNo}, #{refundAmount}, 'REQUESTED', SYSDATE, #{reason} )
mapper.select:
SELECT o.order_no, o.order_status, TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE,
p.pay_no, p.pay_status, p.pay_method, p.pay_amount, TO_CHAR(p.paid_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PAID_AT,
oi.reg_id, oi.order_qty, oi.unit_price, oi.item_total,
r.reg_title, TO_CHAR(r.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DT, TO_CHAR(r.end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DT,
pk.package_id, pk.package_title,
c.ctry_name, l.loc_name, th.theme_title,
i.img_path, i.origin_name FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_no = o.order_no JOIN payment p ON p.order_no = o.order_no JOIN register_prod r ON r.reg_id = oi.reg_id JOIN packages pk ON pk.package_id = r.package_id JOIN country c ON c.ctry_id = pk.ctry_id JOIN location l ON l.loc_id = pk.loc_id LEFT JOIN p_theme th ON th.theme_id = pk.theme_id
LEFT JOIN img_mapping m ON m.reg_id = r.reg_id AND m.view_sequence = ( SELECT MIN(m2.view_sequence) FROM img_mapping m2 WHERE m2.reg_id = r.reg_id ) LEFT JOIN img_storage i ON i.img_no = m.img_no
WHERE o.user_id = #{value} AND p.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC, o.order_date DESC

WITH base AS ( SELECT o.ORDER_NO, o.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME,
MIN(oi.REG_ID) AS REG_ID, MIN(rp.REG_TITLE) AS REG_TITLE,
MAX(p.PAY_NO) AS PAY_NO, NVL(MAX(p.PAY_AMOUNT), MAX(o.TOTAL_PRICE)) AS PAY_AMOUNT, NVL(MAX(p.PAID_AT), MAX(o.ORDER_DATE)) AS PAID_AT_DT, COALESCE(MAX(p.PAY_STATUS), MAX(o.ORDER_STATUS), 'PENDING') AS PAY_STATUS
FROM ORDERS o JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = o.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN REGISTER_PROD rp ON rp.REG_ID = oi.REG_ID WHERE 1=1
AND p.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = p.PAY_NO)
AND COALESCE(p.PAY_STATUS, o.ORDER_STATUS, 'PENDING') IN ('CANCEL','CANCELED','CANCELLED')
AND COALESCE(p.PAY_STATUS, o.ORDER_STATUS, 'PENDING') = #{status}
AND NVL(p.PAID_AT, o.ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND NVL(p.PAID_AT, o.ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY o.ORDER_NO, o.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, b.USER_ID AS userId, b.USER_NAME AS userName, b.REG_ID AS regId, b.REG_TITLE AS regTitle, b.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, TO_CHAR(b.PAID_AT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS paidAt, CASE
WHEN b.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = b.PAY_NO) THEN 'REFUND'
ELSE b.PAY_STATUS
END AS payStatus, CASE WHEN b.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = b.PAY_NO) THEN '환불' WHEN b.PAY_STATUS IN ('CANCEL','CANCELED','CANCELLED') THEN '취소' ELSE '-' END AS cancelRefund, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.PAID_AT_DT DESC, b.ORDER_NO DESC) rn FROM base b ) WHERE rn BETWEEN (#{offset} + 1) AND (#{offset} + #{limit})

WITH base AS ( SELECT o.ORDER_NO FROM ORDERS o JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = o.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE 1=1
AND p.PAY_NO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFUND r WHERE r.PAY_NO = p.PAY_NO)
AND COALESCE(p.PAY_STATUS, o.ORDER_STATUS, 'PENDING') IN ('CANCEL','CANCELED','CANCELLED')
AND COALESCE(p.PAY_STATUS, o.ORDER_STATUS, 'PENDING') = #{status}
AND NVL(p.PAID_AT, o.ORDER_DATE) >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND NVL(p.PAID_AT, o.ORDER_DATE) < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY o.ORDER_NO ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base

SELECT regId, regTitle, startYmd, dday FROM ( SELECT oi.reg_id AS regId, r.reg_title AS regTitle, TO_CHAR(r.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startYmd, (TRUNC(r.start_dt) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS dday, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.start_dt ASC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_no = o.order_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_no = o.order_no JOIN register_prod r ON r.reg_id = oi.reg_id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND NVL(p.pay_status, o.order_status) = 'PAID' AND r.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(r.start_dt) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) WHERE rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY dday ASC

SELECT orderNo, regId, regTitle, packageTitle, startYmd, endYmd, totalPrice, dday, hotelName, hotelTel, hotelCnt, userId FROM (
SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, oi.reg_id AS regId, r.reg_title AS regTitle, pk.package_title AS packageTitle, TO_CHAR(r.start_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startYmd, TO_CHAR(r.end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endYmd, NVL(p.pay_amount, o.total_price) AS totalPrice, (TRUNC(r.start_dt) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS dday, ht.hotel_name AS hotelName, ht.hotel_tel AS hotelTel, NVL(ht.hotel_cnt, 0) AS hotelCnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY r.start_dt ASC, o.order_date ASC, o.order_no ASC, oi.reg_id ASC ) AS rn
FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_no = o.order_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_no = o.order_no JOIN register_prod r ON r.reg_id = oi.reg_id JOIN packages pk ON pk.package_id = r.package_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fh.package_id, fh.hotel_name, fh.hotel_tel, hc.hotel_cnt FROM ( SELECT b.package_id, h.hotel_name, h.hotel_tel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY b.package_id ORDER BY b.day_no ASC, b.seq ASC ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT pi.package_id AS package_id, TO_NUMBER(pi.by_date) AS day_no, pi.pitem_no AS seq, pi.hotel_id AS hotel_id FROM package_item pi WHERE pi.hotel_id IS NOT NULL ) b JOIN hotels h ON h.hotel_id = b.hotel_id ) fh JOIN ( SELECT package_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hotel_id) AS hotel_cnt FROM package_item WHERE hotel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY package_id ) hc ON hc.package_id = fh.package_id WHERE fh.rn = 1 ) ht ON ht.package_id = r.package_id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND NVL(p.pay_status, o.order_status) = 'PAID' AND r.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(r.start_dt) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (TRUNC(r.start_dt) - TRUNC(SYSDATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND #{dayWindow} ) WHERE rn = 1
